scope: Only external comparison preparation; does not expand active independent C1/L1 matrix

common.initialization: inherit actual accepted current N student init path and bytes
common.teacher: same IR seed42 endpoint used by current C1/L1
common.reference: not used by these external selectors
common.device: dynamic shared lease, no hardcoded GPU

candidates.payload: weighted soft BCE with independent sigmoid
candidates.selection: valid dense levels; per-level zero if no native TAL positives
candidates.normalizer: native TAL positive count; explicit PROTOCOL-ADAPTED replacement for original ATSS positive count
candidates.classification_gate: none of C1 E/K or reference-quality gates

candidates.selection: augmented RGB GT feature masks; no C1 E/K gates
candidates.normalizer: author sum/batch; area and background count scaling retained
candidates.auxiliary_parameters: both student and teacher side context transforms trainable; teacher detector frozen

candidates.coverage: Main localization + VLR localization + Main classification; no VLR classification or feature imitation
candidates.kl_reduction: mean along bin/class dimension then T^2; KL(T||S)
candidates.normalization: preserve author per-edge divisors Main=4 VLR=16 and positive-based classification; adapt batch-sum localization to image average explicitly

loss_integration: native_total.sum() + actual_B * KD_mean_per_image; demonstrate source-to-adapter B factor on fixed tensors, never double-divide already normalized components
outcome_blind: No AP tuning of these frozen internal coefficients; record gradient norms, finite/nonzero behavior; no AP early stop.
before_queue: Freeze executed author source bytes and effective config
Required loss/native invariance and real 24 successful-update canary
VRAM/RSS measured profile and shared lease
Core winner and resource allocation by root
missing_primary_asset: FGD standalone supplement not independently located; no execution-wide block

historical_comparators.CMDistill: PROTOCOL-ADAPTED historical workers8; not current formal denominator
historical_comparators.CCLKD: PROTOCOL-ADAPTED partial LLD+CCL only; not current formal denominator
